volume_one_synopsis: Mriya, an aging shelter mutt, begins in a deliberately cozy world of blankets, treats and small rituals with Nika, a burned-out courier who takes her home. When Mriya follows a strange scent into a service tunnel, she finds both a hidden package and a System interface no human can see. The System classifies intentional hiding as Caches, converts canine instincts into progression and lets dogs claim neglected city spaces. Mriya tries to protect Nika and keep their domestic life intact, but every helpful upgrade also makes humans more dependent on the pack. Refusing the System's Good Dog and Bad Dog choices, she unlocks the rare Stray class. She recruits rival dogs, turns a ruined utility room into the first Pack Hearth and learns to manage three incompatible human followers. Failed construction, species-specific consumables and a trusted human who no longer smells like herself reveal that the System is testing more than survival. By the finale, Mriya secures a provisional territory charter from a hidden administrator. The pack has a home, Nika is safe and the first objective is complete; the final reveal shows that the same canine interface is awakening across the city.

listing_package.title: The Scent System
listing_package.subtitle: A Darkly Comic System Apocalypse LitRPG
listing_package.hook: Cozy for the dogs. Apocalypse for everyone else.
listing_package.description:
Mriya was supposed to find one buried package. Instead, she found the System.

Humans cannot see its menus. Dogs can.

Every hidden Cache offers experience. Every city block can become territory. Every human bond can unlock food, shelter, medicine—or something much worse. When an aging shelter mutt chooses neither Good Dog nor Bad Dog, she unlocks the forbidden Stray class and accidentally founds the city's first canine settlement.

Now Mriya must turn a ruined service tunnel into a home, unite rival dogs and manage the unstable humans who think they are still in charge. But each new facility makes the pack stronger and humanity more dependent. Somewhere beneath the city, a tiny administrator is measuring whether people are useful enough to keep.

For the dogs, it is civilization building. For everyone else, it is the apocalypse.

A darkly comic, dog-POV LitRPG with territory progression, settlement building, pack politics and no harem.
listing_package.cover_brief: Foreground an appealing but alert shelter dog in a warm domestic pool of light; let the lower or rear half of the image reveal a ruined contemporary city, scent trails and restrained interface glyphs. The first read at thumbnail size is charming dog adventure; the second read is dark comic apocalypse. Use a dark palette with one toxic-neon accent, bold legible title type, no gore and no generic cute-cartoon treatment.
listing_package.tone_accuracy_rule: The opening may feel cozy, but subtitle, description and secondary cover read must signal the later black comedy and system apocalypse.
